# 1 bed apartment for sale

> Glenveagh is pleased to introduce Miller’s Glen Apartments, a striking new collection of beautifully designed apartments in the heart of the bustle and excitement of Swords, County Dublin. Miller’s Glen embodies modern, stylish living in the friendly surroundings of Swords - a warm, welcoming and well-established area famed for its sense of community.

- Druh nabídky: sale
